questions.question: Jesus told a hunched-over woman in the synagogue that she was set free from her disability. True or false?
Why was the synagogue leader angry when Jesus healed a woman who could not stand up straight?

answers.text: Jesus went past the time set for worship

questions.question: Jesus told the angry synagogue leader that on the Sabbath, people do what for their ox or donkey?

answers.text: Untie it from the stall and lead it to water
Leave it tied in the stall until evening
Brush it down and let it rest all day

questions.question: When Jesus defended healing the woman who was hunched over, He said Satan was the one who had kept her bound. True or false?
